acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-014 gains a criterion: publication, installation, deployment and live-health observations are each accepted and reported with their own kind and kept as key-item proof (protected by kind, moved into the vault when cold), while a dry run's kind is never a protection and a superseded dry run is trimmed with no vault copy. Tests assert positive copy-localization selection (REQ-cli-010), every delivery kind recorded and reported as itself with a dry run as a dry run (REQ-cli-014, REQ-cli-017), and the retention distinction for each kind. Each new test fails under a recorded targeted mutation that the existing tests let pass; no runtime change. fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.
